script: SetTooltip smCerberusStart "Escape an abandoned mining colony aboard Second Wind, a patched Cerberus with a skeleton crew. Find a port with Castle and build a mercenary company. Includes finite prepaid preparation stores at the conversion port."
options: 6:smCerberusStart:Captain of the Second Wind (Marines story start)

text: When the mine closed, your crew patched a grounded Cerberus into flight. They call you captain because you got them out. You have 500 credits to your name. Castle holds the conversion payment separately, with prepaid stores for your first shuttle repair and squad. First you need a port, a converted ship, a repaired shuttle, and trained marines. This start replaces the Galatia tutorial with the Second Wind prologue and company preparation.
